name: Teen Volunteer Days
what_you_do: Teens spend a Saturday hour caring for the park. Jobs may include raking, weeding or mulching depending on the season.
who_can_apply: Teens. The page says ages 13 to 18 in one place and 13 to 17 in another, so ask which applies to you. A parent or guardian must sign a consent form.
duration: Saturdays 1:00 to 2:00 pm, April to June and September to December
deadline_text: Sign-ups open about four weeks before each session. No sign-up link was posted as of Oct 12, 2026.
how_to_apply: Register in advance when a sign-up link appears on the page. Space is limited. You get an email the Thursday before with details and a waiver. Use the contact link on the page for questions.
notes: No one can join without the waiver. Check the page often, because sessions fill up.
